name: Cerezo de Río Tirón (Spain)
description: Square white flag with three triangles issuing from the hoist, green, red and blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Cerezo de Río Tirón (a tower between trees above waves).
history: The arms and the flag were approved officially on 22 March 2001 (Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León no. 71 of 9 April 2001); the flag is square, white, with three gyrons from the hoist, green, red and blue, spaced 1/10 from each other and from the edges and 6/10 deep, with the municipal arms at its heart.

features.role: uppermost of three triangles from the hoist, 6/10 deep
